name: Sonos
description: Control your Sonos speakers through Home Assistant. The card shows the active group of speakers (for example P5 + P1) with volume and play/pause; tap it to control volume and play/pause, pick a group, build a group by adding or removing speakers, and choose content. Pick the Sonos media players.
author: Stefan Verstege (newmedia)
